summary: Describes the role of link indications, information from the link layer to higher layers about link state, in the Internet architecture. Used well, they can improve performance, but misuse can hurt robustness and performance. The memo summarizes proposals and architectural issues. It is informational.

eli5.summary: The cable layer can tell the layers above, hey, I just lost the signal. This note asks when listening is smart and when it causes trouble.

questions: how should higher layers use link layer information
